updates.title: Share screenshots!
updates.description:
Now if you want to share the link to a document or a screenshot with the map location, you can see them at the top of the map when you select a location, try it out!

updates.title: QoL and locations!
updates.description:
Whole bunch of locations, thanks to everyone from github and twitter helping out with the locations.

You can now move between locations using A,D, <- and ->.

Locations now show if they require a key from the map.

Experimenting with the vertical mode, made for those that use vertical monitors. Changed the navigation of the entire desktop experience to make it quicker to move around. Lots of new locations.

Added two links, one for issues found in the site and one specific for those that want to contribute, please make sure to read everything.

We got a simple logo and a social image, hope it looks at least decent. Will focus on adding more locations now.
